marks.text_zh: 约07:00起：轻装甲车机枪射击公路左侧400-500名中国军队（此处只画其中残存的小股）
marks.text_en: From about 07:00: tankette machine guns fire on 400-500 Chinese left of the main road (the remaining small groups are drawn)
marks.label: 未核实
marks.src: jp-038 (未核实), F13 (核实): the hour inside the morning is 推测

marks.text_zh: 08:00 开始炮击中华门（联队炮、野战重炮，城门几乎无损）
marks.text_en: 08:00 the shelling of the gate begins (regimental guns and field heavy artillery; the gate barely damaged)
marks.label: 核实

marks.text_zh: 上午：轻装甲车中队在中华门外村落缴获汽油200罐
marks.text_en: Morning: the light armoured company captures 200 cans of petrol in a village outside the gate
marks.label: 未核实

marks.text_zh: 约正午：6名日军乘小船渡护城河，被机枪阻在水上
marks.text_en: About noon: six Japanese in a small boat on the moat are stopped by a machine gun
marks.label: 未核实

marks.text_zh: 12:10 中华门爆破的一瞬（朝日照片），九四式轻装甲车在画面中
marks.text_en: 12:10 the moment of the blast at 中华门 (Asahi photo), Type 94 tankettes in the frame
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: jp-019, jp-059 (the hour as printed; what blew is 推测)

marks.text_zh: 12:10 九四式轻装甲车停在桥南端，车头对着城门
marks.text_en: 12:10 the Type 94 tankettes halt at the south end of the bridge, nose to the gate
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: jp-059, jp-093 (count 未核实); timeline ev-1212-zhonghua-tankettes

marks.text_zh: 12:20 第47联队第3中队占领中华门西侧城墙一角
marks.text_en: 12:20 the 3rd Company of the 47th holds a corner of the wall west of the gate
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: F15, jp-019 (the place of the corner is 推测)

marks.text_zh: 下午：日军在城门前放火造烟幕；工兵扶住便桥
marks.text_en: Afternoon: the Japanese set a fire before the gate as a smoke screen; engineers hold makeshift bridges aloft
marks.label: 未核实

marks.text_zh: 下午：东侧守军先开炮，随后成批投降
marks.text_en: Afternoon: on the east side the defenders fire their infantry guns, then surrender in waves
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: F17, jp-016 (the claims of 700 killed, 1,500+ captured are the Japanese unit's own)

marks.label: 推测
marks.src: wall.json gates zhonghua tower.damaged (the hour is 推测)

marks.text_zh: 约16:30-17:00 城墙在炮火下坍塌
marks.text_en: About 16:30-17:00 the wall crumbles under the guns
marks.label: 核实

marks.text_zh: 约16:30-17:00 城墙在炮火下开始坍塌
marks.text_en: About 16:30-17:00 the wall begins to crumble under the guns
marks.label: 核实

marks.text_zh: 入夜前后 日军占领中华门城门与城墙
marks.text_en: By nightfall the Japanese hold the gate and the wall
marks.label: 核实
